title: Fabric client logic and mod protocol expectations
evidence_and_consequence: Fabric server helper and registry/assets/data sync are implemented (`fabric_server.cpp`, `fabric_sync.cpp`), plus a native DLL API. Java Fabric client mixins/renderers/screens/custom channels are not executed natively, so “Fabric support” must not imply arbitrary client mod compatibility. Server gameplay can work while native modded blocks/items/entities render incorrectly or custom handshakes fail.
